mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may lower seizure threshold while amphetamine increases CNS stimulation and seizure risk; amphetamine also increases cardiac workload which may be exacerbated by fluoroquinolone-associated QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased CNS stimulation, seizure activity, and cardiac arrhythmias; consider alternative antibiotic if amphetamine use is essential; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring may be warranted.
